description:
=== DONE (s481a) ===

CHANGELOG.md's `## v0.1.0 -- 2026-08-23` section gained a pasteable opening --
what PCL is in three sentences, four measured facts taken from docs/STATUS.md
rather than restated (loops 3-5x faster; 18,581 pass / 649 fail = 96.6 % of the
extracted perl suite, 58 of 108 files complete; the CPAN board 84 / 50 / 49 of
183; the output is meant to be read), the honest "an experiment until the
critical infrastructure runs" hedge, and how to try it -- marked with an HTML
comment saying where the Release text ends.  The tag's own install sentence is
left TRUE FOR THE TAG: v0.1.0 predates the vendored cl-ppcre and still needs it
from ASDF, and the block says so in one sentence.  This batch is an Unreleased
entry; Unreleased is otherwise untouched.

DECISION FOR THE USER (on the checklist): publish v0.1.0 as it is, or cut
v0.1.1 from main once this batch is pushed -- the second fires container.yml so
the release and the image appear together and the README's install lines are
true of the tag people land on.  Recommended.

The empty untracked memory/ at the repo root is removed (rmdir; zero entries).
It lives in the main checkout, not in an agent worktree, so the removal happened
there; the only thing in the tree naming it was a comment in PCLLicense.pm,
corrected.
subject: P3: a pasteable v0.1.0 block in CHANGELOG.md for the GitHub Release form, an Unreleased entry for this batch, and the empty untracked root memory/ removed
